name: canvora
description: Turn any idea, URL, or document into on-brand marketing visuals: posts, carousels, ads, and slides in 100+ formats and 150+ languages. Bundles the Canvora connector with 12 task skills (carousels, pitch decks, PDFs, ad sets, landing-page kits, localization).

api_key.title: Canvora API key
api_key.description: Optional, for the canvora CLI the skills use (canvora.ai → Integrations → API Keys, all plans incl. Free). The Canvora connector signs in with OAuth and doesn't need it.
